description: This file defines a function to clean up resources associated with failed 'ACPs' (possibly Adaptive Control Plane or similar). It includes importing external modules, defining a type for a runtime handle, and exporting an async cleanup function that handles closing sessions, unbinding bindings, and optionally deleting session data.

classes.name: AcpSpawnRuntimeCloseHandle
classes.description: Type describing a handle with a runtime close method and session handle information.

methods.name: export async function cleanupFailedAcpSpawn(params: { cleanupFailedAcpSpawn
methods.description: Performs cleanup procedures when an ACP spawn fails, including shutting down runtime, closing sessions, unbinding sessions, and optionally deleting session data.
